name: Raise Skeleton
description: When a nearby enemy Minion dies, it becomes a Skeletal Warrior with 240~~0.04~~ Health that attacks for 21~~0.04~~ damage and lasts up to 12 seconds. Upon death, Skeletal Warriors deal 40~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies.  Up to 3 Skeletal Warriors can be active at once when spawned in this way.
